140_EN1.篇名: BWV 140 - Wachet auf, ruft uns die Stimme

1.4: Awake, calls the voice to us
1.5: of the watchmen high up in the tower;
1.8: they call to us with bright voices;
1.11: rise up and take your lamps,
1.15: you must go to meet him.

2.20: O daughters of Zion, come out,
2.21: his course runs from the heights
2.23: The Bridegroom comes, who like a roe
2.26: to you he brings the wedding feast.
2.29: there, look, he comes this way.

3.31: 3. Aria - Duet S B (Dialogue - Soul, Jesus)
3.32: When will you come, my Savior?

4.43: her heart leaps for joy within her,
4.45: Her glorious beloved comes from heaven,
4.46: strong in mercy, powerful in truth,
4.47: her light becomes bright, her star rises.
4.49: Lord Jesus, the Son of God!
4.53: and hold the evening meal together.

5.60: I will set you upon my heart,
5.61: upon my arm as a seal,
5.65: which you have had to suffer;
5.66: upon my left hand you shall rest,
5.67: and my right hand shall kiss you.

6.69: 6. Aria - Duet S B (Dialogue - Soul, Jesus)
6.76: where complete pleasure and delight will be.

7.79: Let Gloria be sung to you
7.81: with harps and even with cymbals.
7.82: Of twelve pearls the portals are made,
7.83: In your city we are companions
7.84: Of the angels high around your throne.
